items.title: Live: Interest rates stay steady but RBA leaves door open to further hikes
items.description: The Reserve Bank has kept interest rates on hold at 4.35 per cent at its June meeting, providing a reprieve for borrowers after three consecutive rate hikes, with local shares flat despite a Wall Street rally overnight. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: El Niño declared by BOM, and it could become the strongest on record
items.description: El Niño is a state which can linger for up to 12 months and disrupt weather patterns across the globe, with Australia especially prone.

items.title: Two men arrested by Dezi Freeman investigators
items.description: Police executed seven warrants at properties across Victoria and New South Wales this morning.

items.title: Birth doula says lack of consent delayed Triple Zero call for dying mother
items.description: A court probing the death of Stacey Warnecke after a freebirth has heard that emergency care was delayed for several minutes because her "birth keeper" would only call an ambulance if she consented.

items.title: Trump's 'American flag blue' Reflecting Pool turns green after renovation
items.description: A $20 million renovation of Washington, DC's Reflecting Pool set out to fix leaks and turn the water blue. Mother Nature had other plans.

items.title: The war has been a disaster for Trump and his aims in Iran are unmet
items.description: The ceasefire agreement fits a pattern from Donald Trump where the signing of a deal appears to be the major goal and the details often seem a distant secondary consideration.

items.title: Eight crew believed dead in California B-52 bomber crash
items.description: A US Air Force B-52 bomber, designed to carry nuclear and conventional weapons, crashes shortly after taking off at an air base.

items.title: Live: PM confirms Treasury will release discussion paper for 'further input' on CGT changes
items.description: Anthony Albanese says Treasury will release a discussion paper for "further input" on CGT changes, after Finance Minister Katy Gallagher reveals an extension to the fuel excise cut is under "active consideration". Follow live.

items.title: Iran's players celebrated at World Cup but complicated feelings remain
items.description: After a challenging, politically charged build-up to their World Cup campaign Iran's 2-2 draw with New Zealand brought mixed feelings for the Iranian diaspora.

items.title: Solomon Islands PM floats Pacific-wide security treaty in sharp pivot
items.description: Solomon Islands's new prime minister raises the idea of a Pacific-wide security treaty while meeting Prime Minister Anthony Albanese this month.

items.title: 91yo's 'best mate' saved from house fire by quick-thinking police officer
items.description: A fast-acting police officer has saved a feisty Chihuahua from a burning home in the South Burnett.

items.title: Artemis III pilot Luca Parmitano recalls witnessing bushfires from space
items.description: Luca Parmitano was commanding the International Space Station when bushfires devastated eastern Australia. He has a blunt warning for the future of the planet.

items.title: Albury ratepayers asked to consider rate hike of up to 42pc over two years
items.description: Albury residents could face one of the largest NSW council rate increases of recent years, with councillors voting to seek community feedback on plans to help address its estimated $18 million of debt.

items.title: Rabbits are everywhere in the wild, so why is rabbit meat so expensive?
items.description: Once a cheap meat for families doing it tough, the price and availability of rabbit means it has gone from family dinner to fine dining.

items.title: My parents were much older than those of my peers — it made life difficult
items.description: Having older parents has shaped my life in many ways, including taking on a carer role for Mum and Dad in my 20s.

items.title: With the success of 007 First Light, the future of James Bond is looking bright
items.description: While producers are still mulling over who will take the Bond mantle from Daniel Craig, the super-spy has already moved on in 007 First Light.

items.title: Five positive things having cash in the bank can do for you
items.description: Saving is not the only tool you need to achieve financial security these days, but it still has a role to play if you can manage it.

items.title: Mum describes 'gut-wrenching' moment baby taken in car theft
items.description: The mother of a baby taken as part of a car theft says more action needs to be taken to keep streets safe, as police continue their investigations.

items.title: Man arrested after allegedly assaulting four cops, biting two, during arrest
items.description: A man has been arrested after he allegedly assaulted a woman and a group of police officers in regional South Australia.

items.title: Feud erupts as consumers on the hook for billion-dollar grid blowout
items.description: Transgrid wants to claw back huge cost increases for a major transmission line from consumers. Experts say the regulator's decision will have far-reaching consequences.

items.title: Mother of murdered Broome man slams WA Police culture
items.description: Ingrid Bishop says poor culture within WA Police hampered the investigation into her son Josh Warneke's death from the start.

items.title: Sydney shark attack victim loses arm ahead of 'long' recovery, family says
items.description: The family of Sydney mother Leah Stewart, who was mauled by a shark at Coogee Beach, says she has more surgeries scheduled for coming days.

items.title: Man sentenced to life in prison for 'brutal' murder of 22yo partner
items.description: Braden Jentian, 38, has been sentenced to life behind bars for the "protracted and highly brutal murder" of his 22-year-old female partner, whose body was found in a vacant block in Katherine in 2024.

items.title: Townsville Mayor Nick Dametto breaks silence on assault investigation
items.description: Queensland police are investigating an alleged altercation between the 42-year-old councillor and a 28-year-old man.

items.title: Killer slaughtered chickens before murdering 10-year-old girl, inquest hears
items.description: Biddy Porter's killer was found not criminally responsible for her murder in NSW in 2020. After years of campaigning from her parents, a coronial inquest is examining the lead-up to Biddy's death.
